race.comment: DIAMOND LUCY (15) produced an eye-catching finish when charging home to be beaten only by half-a-length into fourth place at Cairns last start. She won with Chris Whiteley in the saddle before that, and with his return for this assignment, she can take this out. STORM CAPITAL (7) has attracted market support at his two starts since returning from a break but has not quite delivered. He is likely to be peaking at the right time for this, and maybe the addition of hoof pads can bring the best out of him. Stick with him on an each-way basis. BRIGINSHAW (13) showed good ability when breaking through for a maiden victory at this track with Ivo Fry aboard.  He has been freshened up, and a good gate, makes him hard to beat again. ESPRIT LAD (2) will be up in weight chasing a hat-trick of wins, but he is up to the task. MISS KIYOSHI (14) won easily fresh up at a Hughenden picnic meeting, an he should not be risked in this, despite the rise in class.
